summary: Verified two visual edits on SafeSphere AI hero: (1) .earth-readout label removed from DOM, (2) .earth-stage now has computed transform matrix(1,0,0,1,112,0) i.e. translateX(112px). Spinning Earth video element present and visually renders. Hero copy (heading, search, city pills) intact on left. Weather, risk, financial, emergency sections all render below hero. No console errors.

issues: With Earth shifted +112px, the right edge of the Earth video is very close to viewport right edge at 1920px width (rect.right=1752). Fine on laptop, but check on smaller viewports for potential overflow/clipping.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider using a CSS variable for the 112px shift so it can be responsive (e.g., translateX shrinks on narrower viewports).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero edits verified: querySelector('.earth-readout')===null, getComputedStyle('.earth-stage').transform==='matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 112, 0)'. Video data-testid='spinning-earth-video' present, visually rendered NASA Earth mp4. All below-fold sections render.
